messages:
Leah: Hey team — AuroraCompute shared final launch assets: hero photo + logo variants + quote. Need design QA (logo lockups, clearspace), alt text + photo credit, microcopy for one-pager CTA, and legal confirmation for model/person releases. Links below.

Marcus: Quick pass — hero looks great but contrast low on mobile. Recommend 36% black gradient overlay + bolder H1. Stacked logo has a 1px misalignment on the 'A' from an export; can you share original SVG?

Priya: Legal: need signed model releases & trademark permissions. Also confirm partner review window. Guideline: https://auroracompute.com/brand-usage

Tom: Marketing: I can draft hero line, 1-sentence blurb, and CTA. Options: "Get started" / "See benchmarks" / "Request demo" — prefer short CTAs.

Carlos (AuroraCompute): Uploaded originals + releases here: https://files.auroracompute.com/redwood-presspack-2024.zip. We can accept a 72-hour review window.

Marcus: Got the SVGs, thanks @Carlos. Exporting patched PNGs + mobile gradient variant. Will add alt text proposal and photo credit.

Leah: Photo credit per release: "Photo: Lina Santos / AuroraCompute". Marcus, can you propose alt and short description for one-pager?

Marcus: Alt suggestion: "Three engineers reviewing GPU cluster logs in a data center, soft evening light; team collaborating around a laptop." Short description: "Engineering team discussing performance metrics in front of rack-mounted GPUs; photo used to illustrate production inference at scale." Photographer credit file added.

Priya: Reviewed PDFs — releases cover pictured individuals for worldwide marketing; trademark rule: use `AuroraCompute` camel case, no hyphenation, and minimum logo exclusion 6px at small sizes. Posting legal OK; 72h review confirmed.

Tom: Draft copy:
Hero: "Inference engineered for production"
Blurb (one sentence): "Redwood and AuroraCompute deliver low-latency, cost-efficient LLM serving across cloud and on-prem with enterprise controls."
CTA: "Request a demo"
Social (<=140 chars): "Redwood + AuroraCompute: production-grade LLM inference with predictable throughput and enterprise controls."

Leah: Tighten the blurb to a single sentence (good). Leave a slot under the logo for partner tagline — @Tom please reserve space. Marcus, please leave safe margin.

asset-bot: Upload complete — 12 files added to https://redwood.app/drive/aurora-presspack-v2  checksum: 4a7c9f2

Marcus: CSS snippet if helpful:
```
.hero-overlay { background: linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.36), rgba(0,0,0,0.36)); }
.hero-headline { font-weight:700; color:#FFFFFF; text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
```

Leah: Great work. I'll open sign-off thread in #partnerships-signoff once final layout is in the drive. Closing this thread; follow-ups there. :rocket:
